changes: Shared HTTP/HTTPS gateway negotiates streaming gzip for finite JSON >=1024 bytes; SSE, ranges, no-transform, HEAD and already encoded responses excluded. Browser decodes original JSON; no schema/history/authority change.

Loom module demand loader retains exact official PanelFallback and native page components, immediately publishes resolved modules and retains nested Suspense handling; aborts late mounted-page state updates and propagates import failures.
Computer auto-selection checks actual current destination before using a render-captured router setter; stale callbacks cannot resurrect an old destination.

method.browser: Existing Chrome, viewport 1440x1000, no network or CPU throttle
method.backend: Same live Core/data both arms; identical controlled proxy/static gzip. Before arm serves previous immutable UI and requests identity API responses, matching previous API transport. After serves new UI and forwards encoding negotiation.
method.scope: Local HTTP controlled comparison, not remote-device latency or Firefox full-page HTTPS
method.cold: HTTP cache bypass (no-store), not new browser/JIT process
method.warm: Primed static-resource cache, API remains no-store
method.ready: composer and 54 message DOM elements, no alert, then two frames. Resources collected ready+400ms; transferSize excludes navigation document/probe.
method.click: real captured click to visible target page plus two frames; measures presentation not all async data or INP. 6 paired journeys, each 6 pages and 2 cycles.
method.sampling: 24 alternating successful loads; 144 successful measured clicks; no exclusions, blocked API paths or failed journeys.
method.noDataMutation: No messages, role configurations or CLI work created. Normal channel read acknowledgements allowed.

browserAcceptance.desktop: Formal product switched Computers -> Tasks; nine task cards loaded. Same channel renders 54 message DOM nodes with no alert.
browserAcceptance.mobile: 390x844 formal task/Agent/chat pages visible; mobile Agent nav target 68.8x44, actual center hit true. No viewport emulation claimed as real-device acceptance.

limits: First page presentation improved; full bootstrap ready time did not consistently improve. Cold median418->421ms, warm298->333ms, broad ranges overlap; do not claim startup acceleration.

Computer stale callback reproduced in isolated test; previous browser missed-navigation symptoms are compatible with it but not proven exclusively caused by it. Both arms had zero missed destinations in this repetition.
Compression reduces wire bytes, not decoded JSON/parse work, source data size or model tokens.
No authenticated live Raft comparator, Firefox timing, long-running stutter acceptance or physical mobile acceptance.
conclusion: First-open five-page median improved from327-334ms to34-61ms. Warm refresh resource transfer425305->78382 bytes (-81.57%); cold1885524->1538717 (-18.39%). Repeat navigation stays approximately21-37ms; startup latency not improved consistently.
